re_review_note: Re-review. Prior evidence was delivered at an older head (8291e1f); this review independently re-inspects the full diff at the current head c13ac3173d7bba6e9903afabd5705abc88774e3c against master. The branch contains exactly one commit on top of master: c13ac31 'feat(mcp-stdio-rs): capture child stderr tail on transport-closed errors'.
reason: The change implements StderrPolicy (Inherit default | Capture with 8 KiB default / 1 MiB clamp), a bounded VecDeque-backed ring, an EOF-signalled drain task, and appends the captured tail to transport-closed, request-failure, initialize-failure, and writer-closed error paths. Default behaviour is preserved (Inherit). The ring caps memory (chatty children never block because cap==0 discards and the pipe is always drained); drain/shutdown loops are bounded (STDERR_EOF_WAIT 250 ms, timeout + abort handle on join expiry). Tests exercise the new behaviour end-to-end via a fail-stderr fixture server. No secrets added, no swallowed errors (write/reader loop failures still propagate; only sender-drop is ignored), no unbounded loop or I/O, and no weakened checks. Build, clippy, and full test suite pass at this head.
